column1: # TTU internal state-file slot map (ttuAddr[U16] -> contents), recovered from binary
# analysis of the CUDA-13 RT toolchain: the RT-intrinsic->SASS lowering, our ptxas
# decompile (opcode emitters confirmed at the disassembly level), nvdisasm class
# The ttuAddr index is a 16-bit immediate carried in SASS instruction bits[55:40]
# (md_ field BITS_16_55_40 / Ra_offset; verified by hand-encode + nvdisasm round-trip).
# It is a BYTE OFFSET into a 16-byte-granular state file, 16-byte aligned (low nibble 0).
# Each TTUST writes one 16-byte slot from a register pair (Rb-pair, Rc-pair) = U32 reg[4].
# Each TTULD reads one 16-byte slot into (Rd2:Rd) plus a predicate Pu. Writable input
# region = [0x000,0x300); readable output region = [0x300,0x3F0). Total space 0x600.
# Columns: slot_index_hex  dir  contents  written_by  read_by  format

column3: RayFlags (primary slot): type, cullMode, frontFaceCW, terminateOnHit, stackLimit, rayOp, traversalOrder, instMask, 8x2b RTT modes, rayOpParamA/B
column6: U32 reg[4] 96b: TYPE[2:0] CULLMODE[5:4] FRONTFACECW[6] TERMINATEONHIT[7] STACKLIMIT[10:8] INSTNODEPTR[12] STORE_T[13] REPORTONENTER[14] NOPOPONRETURN[15] RAYOP[19:16] TRAVERSALORDER[23:21] INSTMASK[31:24] MODE_*[55:32] RAYOPPARAMA[79:64] RAYOPPARAMB[95:80]
U32 reg[4]: ORIGIN_X[31:0] ORIGIN_Y[63:32] ORIGIN_Z[95:64] TMIN[127:96], all FP32
U32 reg[4]: DIRECTION_X[31:0] DIRECTION_Y[63:32] DIRECTION_Z[95:64] TMAX[127:96], all FP32

column3: RayFlags2 (bottom/dual slot, HW instancing): same layout as RayFlags
column6: U32 reg[4], same bit layout as 0x000
U32 reg[4]: ORIGIN_X/Y/Z FP32, TMIN slot ignored
U32 reg[4]: DIRECTION_X/Y/Z FP32, TMAX slot ignored

column3: StackInitComplet: BVH root pointer (the traversal entry point)
column6: U32 reg[4]: NODEREF[63:0] (49b complet ptr + enterRoot flag) INSTANCEPTR[112:64]

column3: StackInitTriRange: triangle range to intersect + current instance ptr
StackInitTriFetch: triangle range for vertex fetch
Hit result (union; also TTUCLOSE default slot): t, u, v, primId, instance, hit type/miss
column6: U32 reg[4]: TYPE[127:124]; Triangle: USERTRIANGLEID[31:0] T=reg[1]&0x7FFFFFFF U=reg[2]&0x7FFFFFFF V=reg[3]&0x7FFFFFFF ALPHA=reg[1]>>31 BACKFACING=reg[2]>>31; type 0xF=miss/None 0xE=Error

column3: HitTrianglePtr: TTUTriRange of the hit triangle (single-tri range)
HitInstance: user instance id (lo/hi) + 49b instance pointer

column6: U32 reg[4]: ORIGIN_X/Y/Z FP32, DIRECTION_X[127:96] FP32

column3: TriFetch0: fetched triangle vertices v0.xyz + v1.x
column6: U32 reg[4]: V0X V0Y V0Z V1X, all FP32
U32 reg[4]: V1Y V1Z V2X V2Y, all FP32

column3: TriFetch2: v2.z + userTriangleID + alpha + predicate + error
column6: U32 reg[4]: V2Z[31:0] USERTRIANGLEID[63:32] ALPHA[64] PREDICATE[95] ERROR_CODE[101:96]

column3: TriFetch3: TTUTriRange of the fetched triangle
return Stack primary entries 0/1 (+ meta; reg[1]==0 => traversal terminated)
Invalid sentinel (used by TTU commands that carry no address: OPEN/GO/CLOSE w/o explicit addr)
AddressSpaceSize: total size of the TTU state file (1536 bytes)
